people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

people.name: Leah
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: In the morning, behold, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”
translations.bsb: When morning came, there was Leah! “What have you done to me?” Jacob said to Laban. “Wasn’t it for Rachel that I served you? Why have you deceived me?”
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled
translations.asv: And it came to pass in the morning that, behold, it was Leah. And he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? Did not I serve with thee for Rachel? Wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?
